Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_Thrusters_toolt:
The Roadster Rocket's thrusters: kickflip, backflip, boost, flight and the automatic soft landing. Off: none of them work.
Default on.
Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_FlightSeconds_t:
A full air tank lasts this many seconds of flight.
2–120, default 8.
Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_FreeFlight_tool:
Flying uses no air and lasts until you land. Kickflip, backflip, boost and the soft landing still use air.
Default off.
Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_ThrusterRefillM:
An empty air tank refills in this many in-game minutes, powered by the high voltage battery.
1–1440, default 30.
Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_ThrusterRefillK:
Energy a full refill of the air tank takes from the high voltage battery. Off a charger it stops refilling rather than take the battery under 5%%.
0–150, default 40.
Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_SemiSpawnChance:
Chance in %% that each long parking lot in the world gets a parked Tesla Semi, rolled once per lot. The 53 ft trailer is rolled separately with twice this chance; the two are never hitched.
Only on clear ground: never in a safehouse or on a wall, tree, car or anything built or dropped. Areas already explored in an existing save get them too, once.
0 = none.
Default 1.5.
Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_RangeMultiplier:
How far a full battery drives (0.25 to 10).
1.0 = as far as a full tank in a vanilla car of the same class; 2.0 = twice as far.
Vanilla Gas Consumption also affects it: set that to 2 for half the range, or to 0 so driving uses no charge.
Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_ChargeSpeedMult:
1.0 = official charger power (Wall Connector 11.5 kW, Mobile Connector 7.6 kW, Supercharger up to 250 kW, 325 kW for the Cybertruck, 1200 kW for the Semi)
2.0 = twice as fast.
Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_ChargeFuelMulti:
Generator fuel a Tesla burns: the charge, and the car's climate and Camp Mode while plugged in. Grid power is free.
1.0 = about one tank to charge a Model Y from empty to full at the default Generator Fuel Consumption; 0.5 = half; 0 = no fuel.
Generator Fuel Consumption scales it too.
Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_CampMinBattery_:
Camp Mode cannot be turned on below this charge and turns off when the battery drops under it.
Like the real car's Low Power Mode: 10–20%%, default 20.
Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_BluetoothRange: App Bluetooth range after power cut (tiles)
Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_BluetoothRange_:
While the grid is up, the phone app reaches the car at any distance. After the power goes out it is Bluetooth only: the app reaches the car within this many tiles (1 tile = 1 m). 0 = no link once the power is out.
Summon is also limited by AutoDrive's Summon range (tiles) and the game's vehicle physics range of about 64 tiles; the smallest applies.
Default 50.
